name: SEREIN
description: A poetic identity for a late-night tea salon. A fine crescent, midnight blue, and warm champagne-colored paper create a distinctive mood of intimate sophistication.
heading: prata
rules: The crescent opens to the right and retains a fine inner curve.
Use tracked capitals for the wordmark, never for paragraphs.
Let champagne lines and borders remain subtle against after dark.

system.concept: Moonlit tea objects, celestial hairline diagrams, deep-blue packaging, and gracefully tracked serif capitals. A nocturnal world with unmistakable hospitality.
headline: Stay for
a softer evening.

features: A thoughtful place to let the day become something softer.
Tea with a point of view
Small, considered pleasures and a table worth lingering at.
